seo_title: Click2View Asia Case Study: Reporting Time Saved | SOMIN
description: Click2View Asia used SOMIN's Brand Tracker and SODA to cut monthly client reporting from 9 hours to 1 and comprehensive competitor analysis from 18 hours to 3.
eyebrow: Agency case study · Content marketing · APAC
h1: Click2View Asia cut monthly reporting from 9 hours to 1 with SOMIN
lede: Click2View Asia, an APAC content marketing agency, runs competitor monitoring and client reporting on SOMIN's Brand Tracker and SODA. Monthly reporting fell from 9 hours to 1, and comprehensive competitive analysis from 18 to 3.
meta_line: A SOMIN agency customer story · Asia-Pacific · Content marketing

challenge.title: Click2View Asia's strategist hours went on collating data
challenge.body: The agency builds editorial-quality content for global brands and APAC challengers. Reporting and audits took dozens of hours a cycle, time it needed to grow its consulting.

approach.title: Brand Tracker and SODA as the reporting layer
points: Brand Tracker monitors competitors across clients, sparing several analysts.
SODA writes the category summaries strategists once wrote by hand.
Reclaimed hours go into senior consultation.

findings_title: 80–90% less time on Click2View's repeating workstreams

findings.title: Monthly reporting down from 9 hours to 1
findings.body: An 89% cut. A mini competitive analysis also fell from 9 hours to 1.

findings.title: Competitive deep dives in 3 hours, not 18
findings.body: Content strategy groundwork also fell, from 14 hours to 2.

findings.title: One person per workstream, not two
findings.body: Time on core repeating workstreams fell 80–90%, with matching cost savings.

delivered.title: Four SOMIN modules behind Click2View's client work
points: Brand Tracker for cross-client competitor monitoring
Monthly reports in 1 hour, comprehensive analyses in 3
A SOMIN subscription extended for another engagement window

quote.text: SOMIN and SODA are very helpful solutions that take the legwork out of getting data from disparate sources across clients and platforms

outcome.title: Click2View's reclaimed hours feed upsell and new business
outcome.body: The time goes into strategic work, not just execution. Click2View projects a 100–400% new-business uplift and a 100–200% upsell to existing clients.

faq.q: How much time did Click2View Asia save with SOMIN?
faq.a: Monthly reporting fell from 9 hours to 1, comprehensive competitive analysis from 18 to 3, and content strategy groundwork from 14 to 2.

faq.q: Which SOMIN modules does Click2View Asia use?
faq.a: Brand Tracker, SODA (the analytics assistant), Content Library and Perspective Studies.

faq.q: What business impact does Click2View Asia expect?
faq.a: A 100–400% new-business uplift and a 100–200% upsell to existing clients.
